issues.on_page: Debt Service 8,625.48, DEBT SERVICE ACCOUNT column (row under the Governmental heading)
issues.issue: The Debt Service Account is treated as business-type because its only inflow is Water Fund transfers (8,797.32, p5). This is reasonable but is an assumption. The same applies to the Extension/Replacement account (named W/S on p5), and it decides the governmental/business-type transfer split.

issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other, Cemetery Account 1,600.00 (part of governmental 57,353.59)
issues.issue: The Cemetery Account's local receipts are probably cemetery lot or burial fees (Cemetery Fees). The amount is minor, the line is combined with other funds' 'Other' receipts, and the printed label is 'Other'.
